name: aesir
description: Agentic development platform for automated software workflows

scripts.docker:dev-agent: docker compose up -d dev-agent && docker compose logs -f dev-agent
scripts.docker:product-agent: docker compose up -d product-agent && docker compose logs -f product-agent
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgresql temporal temporal-ui
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose logs -f postgresql temporal temporal-ui
scripts.db:generate: pnpm --filter @aesir/platform db:generate && pnpm --filter @aesir/observability db:generate && pnpm --filter @aesir/integration-linear db:generate && pnpm --filter @aesir/integration-github db:generate && pnpm --filter @aesir/integration-slack db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @aesir/platform db:migrate && pnpm --filter @aesir/observability db:migrate && pnpm --filter @aesir/integration-linear db:migrate && pnpm --filter @aesir/integration-github db:migrate && pnpm --filter @aesir/integration-slack db:migrate
